    is_tight_space = f["distance_m"] < p["tight_space_distance_m"]
    is_direct_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["direct_approach_angle_deg"]

    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_danger_distance_m"]
    is_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_distance_m"]

    was_previous_pass = bool(f["prev_event_was_pass"])

    space_favorable = has_open_space_behind and not is_congested and not is_pinned_to_sideline

    take_on_score = (
        defensive_pressure_favorable
        and space_favorable
        and risk_acceptable
        and (has_speed_advantage or was_previous_pass)
    )

        is_tight_space

        and is_closing_fast
        and has_speed_advantage
        and has_open_space_behind
    )

        is_low_density
        and has_open_space_behind
        and has_low_support
        and not was_previous_pass
    )

        is_attacking_third
        and is_tight_space
        and not is_closing_fast
        and has_open_space_behind
    )

    # パターン4: サイドに追い込まれる前に縦への仕掛けでかわそうとする状況

        is_pinned_to_sideline
        and is_tight_space
        and is_frontal_approach
        and has_speed_advantage
    )

        pattern_speed_advantage
        or pattern_isolated_carrier

    is_defender_head_on = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["safe_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_defender_retreating_or_side = not is_defender_head_on

    if not is_under_pressure:
        take_on = has_space_beyond and not is_congested
    else:
        favorable_duel = is_defender_retreating_or_side or (not is_closing_fast)

        good_conditions = (
            favorable_duel
            and has_space_beyond
            and has_enough_support
            and not is_congested
        )

        risky_position = is_pinned_to_sideline and not has_space_beyond

        take_on = good_conditions and not risky_position

    return 1 if take_on else 0
